CustomField.description: Clear: the review ran, every required source and field was covered, no findings and no failed checks. Findings: findings or failed checks to look at. Incomplete: a required source was missing or required fields were not reviewed. Failed: no usable review (timeout, refusal, HTTP error, malformed or cut-off reply, no files sent) - never treated as clear. Independent of the extraction's status.
CustomField.label: Review Status
